name: Biochemistry PhD
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Catalog fall deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: Department says it reviews on a rolling basis, considers fall applications by mid-March, and advises early submission; confirm availability.

applicationFee.note: Nonrefundable fee. Waivers listed for McNair Scholars, US Armed Forces/Veterans and Native American applicants, under Domestic and Permanent Resident Applicants. Confirm category scope and international eligibility; no unrestricted international waiver established.

documents: Statement of interest, maximum two pages, covering motivation, scientific interests, prospective research groups and scholarly/teaching/research background
Official transcripts/marksheets from every institution, degree documents and English translations where applicable

english.toefl: 81/4.5 as published; department also states old-scale Speaking23 and Writing21
english.note: Department lists IELTS Speaking/Writing6.0. Central exempt-country/degree list applies. Check equivalent new TOEFL section minima with department.

requirements.note: GPA at least3.0; MS not needed. GRE required when degree earned outside US; US-degree applicants encouraged but not required. Preference for quantitative50th percentile and other components at least20th percentile, described as soft guidelines. First-semester rotations in three groups precede supervisor choice; prior faculty contact not needed.

funding.note: Appointed first-year TAs receive an undated $18,000 academic-year salary; up to $24,000 calendar-year total depends on summer PI funds. TA/GRA appointments include full tuition waiver while in good academic standing; continuation depends satisfactory PhD progress. No universal funding guarantee retained.
